name: Contribution Records
description: Contribution records system used by the new www.drupal.org: stores per-issue credit for individuals and organizations as Paragraphs-based nodes, imported/synced from Drupal.org and GitLab issues.
project_description: Contribution Records is the credit-tracking system used by the new (Drupal 10/11) www.drupal.org. It stores contribution credit for individuals and organizations as 'contribution_record' nodes whose contributors are Paragraphs of type 'contributor', kept separate from the underlying issues (which may live on www.drupal.org or on git.drupalcode.org GitLab). Records are created, validated and synced against the live Drupal.org api-d7 endpoint and the GitLab API (via the drupalorg module's services), and can be imported in bulk from the legacy Drupal 7 site via a POST endpoint and a queue worker. The module assumes the surrounding www.drupal.org site configuration already exists (the 'contribution_record' content type, the 'contributor' paragraph type, the field_* fields, and the jsonapi_views/contribution_records views).
